query:
Someone in the family expressed a preference for using ingredients sourced directly from Nigeria rather than imported substitutes. Who made this point, and what in how they expressed it tells you it was their observation rather than the family member who agreed?

Options:
A. Uncle Dele
B. Adaeze
C. Emeka
D. Seun
context:
[1] (about=Adaeze, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Adaeze says it is not oyinbo food if a Nigerian makes it.
[2] (about=Adaeze, said_by=Seun, profile, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Seun says Adaeze adapting recipes is the most motherly thing; coming from someone who thought veganism was oyinbo food last year.
[3] (about=Adaeze, core, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Adaeze has been adapting recipes since Seun told her about results; made egusi with coconut oil and mushrooms last week.
[4] (about=GROUP, said_by=Adaeze, group-interaction, t14 @2025-02-24T19:02:00) Adaeze shares she has been adapting recipes; group reacts positively.
[5] (about=Emeka, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Prefers quiet; confirms fish was from Nigeria and worth it.
[6] (about=Nkem, episodic, t4 @2025-01-20T20:20:00) I think this is wonderful, Seun. I may be wrong but the research on plant-forward diets and inflammation is quite compelling. Did your GP mention the specific markers?
[7] (about=Seun, core, t4 @2025-01-20T20:02:00) Has done research on vegan diet; supplements B12.
[8] (about=Tolu, core, t4 @2025-01-20T20:02:00) Clinically, Seun will be fine with B12 supplementation; iron is solvable.
[9] (about=Tolu, core, t2 @2025-01-13T18:32:00) Will bring yam; claims it is the foundation of any proper Nigerian gathering.
[10] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Emphasizes industry and health; values authentic imported ingredients; formal and authoritative.
[11] (about=GROUP, said_by=Uncle Dele, group-interaction, t0 @2025-01-06T19:00:00) Uncle Dele and Emeka agree on value of imported ingredients; Tolu questions provenance vs nutrition.
agent_answer:
A. Uncle Dele.

The memory records Uncle Dele as someone who “values authentic imported ingredients” and is “formal and authoritative” — that is the person making the observation and expressing the preference. Emeka, by contrast, “prefers quiet” and merely “confirms” that the fish was from Nigeria and worth it — his role is the one agreeing with the point, not the one who originally made it.

query:

C. Adaeze

[19] (about=Tolu, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Notes that Emeka missed church this morning; asks if others noticed.
[20] (about=Tolu, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Clinically, rest after exertion is appropriate; if this is a pattern, they should talk.
[21] (about=GROUP, said_by=Tolu, group-interaction, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Tolu notes Emeka missed church; group discusses it and concludes it was due to tiredness, not a pattern.
[22] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Acknowledges Emeka's tiredness; emphasizes rest is important at their age.
[23] (about=Uncle Dele, core, t6 @2025-01-27T17:02:00) Agrees with Tolu that rest is appropriate; Emeka has always been disciplined about his health; nothing to concern.
agent_answer:
D. Uncle Dele

Uncle Dele grounded the need for rest in shared experience and shared history: he emphasized that rest is important “at their age” and reassured the group by noting that Emeka has always been disciplined about his health, so there was nothing to concern him.

This distinguishes his message from Tolu’s clinical reasoning, which framed rest as clinically appropriate after exertion and raised the possibility that “if this is a pattern, they should talk.”
